code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    colors={v for row in g for v in row if v not in (0,8)}
    if not colors: return g
    color=next(iter(colors))
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==color]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts)
    c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
    shape={(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in pts}
    for dr in range(h-(r1-r0+1)+1):
      for dc in range(w-(c1-c0+1)+1):
        if all(g[dr+rr][dc+cc]==0 for rr,cc in shape):
